cards-about.tile: A light, switch, cover, fan, player, number or sensor as a tile: large with a precision ruler or two readouts, compact row, or mini.
cards-about.tiles: A group of compact or mini tiles, two to four per row, 8 px apart.
cards-about.light: The precision dimmer: relative drag, slide away to slow down, hold for the 1 % scale, colour temperature.
cards-about.lights: A room’s lights on one card: one tap for the whole room, a round, chip, tile or row for each light, in its colour.
cards-about.entities: Rows of entities: a switch for what toggles, the value for what is measured.
cards-about.cover: Blinds, shutters, garage doors and valves: vertical position ruler, tilt, open · stop · close, favourites.
cards-about.fan: Speed ruler with steps, oscillation, direction and presets.
cards-about.sensor: A sensor with its curve, trend, min, max and average, or up to three sensors on one chart.
cards-about.readouts: Up to four values side by side with their trends.
cards-about.people: Who is home: avatars, zones, times and phone batteries, each person with a tap of their own.
cards-about.openings: Doors, windows and motion at a glance, with what is open counted.
cards-about.hello: The greeting: name, date, weather and avatar.
cards-about.chips: A row of chips that navigate between views or open entities.
cards-about.heading: A section title with its count and a link.
cards-about.scene: One scene, script or button as a tile with a done state.
cards-about.scenes: A grid of scenes and scripts.
cards-about.actions: Buttons and scripts as a list with run buttons.
cards-about.helpers: Numbers, selects, texts, booleans and dates as their own controls.
cards-about.todo: A to-do list: check, add, hide the done.
cards-about.timer: A timer counting down live, with pause and cancel.
cards-about.updates: Pending updates with install buttons and progress.
cards-about.gauge: A ring gauge for any numeric sensor with min, max and average, or centred on zero for a meter that runs both ways.
cards-about.stat-tiles: A headline value and a grid of stat tiles.
cards-about.bars: Rows with a bar each: plants, batteries, strings, levels.
cards-about.distribution: One stacked bar and a legend: who draws what.
cards-about.room: A room of the house from its area: its picture, its climate, what is on, and its controls.
cards-about.map: Where everyone is: the house’s zones as columns of faces, a row a person, or Home Assistant’s map on a plate.
cards-about.humidity: Humidity on a comfort band, with dew point and trend.
cards-about.clock: Analog or digital, hero, side or tile, with or without weather.
cards-about.weather: Condition, temperature, feels-like, wind and the daily or hourly forecast.
cards-about.calendar: Agenda, month, week, month + day, timeline, upcoming or tile.
cards-about.media: A media player: artwork, seek bar, transport and volume — full, compact row or hero.
cards-about.now-playing: The compact player of the home screen: artwork, thin progress, transport and volume.
cards-about.remote: A TV remote in Fluvy’s hand: power, sources, a D-pad with OK, playback, volume routed where you like, channels, the apps with their logos, keys of your own.
cards-about.energy: Power right now, the day curve and the energy legend.
cards-about.energy-flow: Where the house’s energy comes from and where it goes, live or over a period: import and export at once, every source, lanes in their origin’s colour.
cards-about.energy-balance: What comes in against what goes out, live or over a period: the house is the remainder, so the totals agree; each phase of the grid, and the money.
cards-about.grid: The grid right now: the net import or export, in and out at once, each phase with its voltage, the price and today’s totals.
cards-about.energy-devices: Where the energy goes, device by device on one scale: nested circuits, and what no meter measures.
cards-about.meters: Today’s water and gas against a typical day, what flows right now, and a leak sensor or a valve beside them.
cards-about.production: Hourly production bars with the forecast behind, stacked per array when there are several.
cards-about.history-bars: A sensor’s last days, weeks or months as bars from its long-term statistics: the total and the average in the head, the value over each bar, and a strip of facts under them — the highest and lowest, or what it comes to in CO₂, trees, kilometres or money.
cards-about.batteries: The house’s batteries as one: their state of charge, full or empty in, the reserve on the ruler, a row per battery and their mode.
cards-about.ev-charger: The car on its charger: its charge against the target, ready by when, what the session added and how much of it came from the sun, the charging mode.
cards-about.energy-sankey: A day, week or month of energy from where to where, in true proportions: the grid, the battery and the sun into the house, the charge and the export, and the house into its devices.
cards-about.energy-score: Self-powered, sun used and low-carbon as rings, the Energy dashboard’s own gauges, over imported, exported and net.
cards-about.energy-period: The view’s date picker as a strip: ‹ the day, week, month or year › and back to today, Home Assistant’s own, so its energy cards follow it as Fluvy’s do.
cards-about.energy-usage: Electricity, water or gas used by the hour, the day or the month, stacked by source or meter.
cards-about.lock: Slide to unlock, never one accidental tap; codes, jammed state, related rows.
cards-about.alarm: Arm modes as tiles and the keypad sheet for codes.
cards-about.camera: A still that refreshes itself, or Home Assistant’s live stream, in the shape you choose; tap for the stream.
cards-about.cameras: Several cameras at a glance, each picture live or refreshing itself with its name and what it sees; a sheet of them all.
cards-about.printer: A 3D printer’s job: progress, time left, heaters, layers, filament and the camera; pause, resume and stop. OctoPrint, PrusaLink, Bambu Lab, Moonraker, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, Snapmaker and FlashForge.
cards-about.automations: Every automation of the house: on or off, run, last and next run; schedules written as native automations, created and edited in a sheet.
cards-about.appliance: A washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven, hob, fridge, coffee machine, pet feeder, fountain, litter box or small appliance on a plug, pictured: what it does, when it is ready, what it uses, its reminders.
cards-about.appliances: The house’s appliances as live rows, or their whole cards side by side: what runs, what is done, what waits.
cards-about.alerts: What needs a look — low batteries, devices gone, doors left open, leaks, updates, repairs — each from one line, as tiles, chips, rows or a banner, hidden while all is clear.
cards-about.template: A tile whose name, line, icon, colour and fill are templates, with or without an entity; a Mushroom template card pastes in.
cards-about.web: A web page on a plate — a map, a chart, a site of your own — under a head, in a frame or bare; sandboxed as Home Assistant’s iframe card is.
cards-about.expander: Any cards folded away under a head: a tap opens them, on one surface or each on its own.
cards-about.slider: Any value on the precision ruler: a player’s volume with its mute, a number or a helper, a fan’s speed, another entity’s switch in its head.
cards-about.vacuum: Robot vacuum or mower: battery, start · stop · dock · locate, suction, a drive pad, its map with presets.
cards-about.thermostat: Climate, water heater or humidifier on a dial, with modes, presets and fan speeds.
cards-about.vehicle: A car, electric, petrol, diesel or plug-in hybrid: its battery or tank, range and charge limit, when it is full, where it is, and its lock, climate, charging, boot and windows in one row. Tesla, BMW, Renault, Volvo, Kia, Hyundai, Volkswagen, Škoda, Polestar, MG, Toyota, Ford, Mercedes-Benz, Peugeot and more.
cards-about.items: The items of a sensor’s list attribute, a row each — flights overhead, departures, deliveries — with a flights preset for FlightRadar24.
cards-about.chart: Any time series on one chart — history, statistics, a list in an attribute (Nordpool’s prices, a solar forecast) or a weather’s forecast — past to future with now marked, thresholds in their colours and the cheapest hours found.
cards-about.swipe: Any cards, one a page, turned by a swipe or the page marks under them: side by side on a wide screen, round from the last to the first.
cards-about.compass: Wind speed and direction, a vehicle’s heading or any bearing on a 360° compass ring, with a secondary marker and up to three readouts underneath.
cards-about.rounds: Any entities as round buttons, each lit while it is on: a tap switches what is safe to switch, a hold opens its details, with an optional head saying how many are on.
cards-about.rooms: Every room in one card: its icon, its name, its temperature and humidity, and its quick actions at its end; a tap opens the room’s page.
cards-about.thermostats: Every thermostat of the house or a room in one card: each room’s temperature, what it is doing, its preset and its target, round buttons and optional − and +, with All off and the presets for the whole house.
cards-about.schedule: A room’s heating week on Home Assistant’s own schedule helper: a timeline a day in its presets’ colours, Comfort, Eco and Away with their temperatures, its times edited, a day copied to others, the schedule on or off.
